record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, index positional embeddings by cumulative nonpadding count rather than absolute padded-array position: pos=(seq!=0).cumsum(1)*(seq!=0). This aligns the same observed-prefix length across training and inference, potentially reducing positional mismatch for short histories. Retain MAXLEN=64, the existing prefix-length feature, causal convolution topology, final-real-position readout, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. Apply identical position construction in the predictor writer; retain one checkpoint per category.
